title: Hausdorff measure of an open ball in an m-dimensional linear subspace (parent Step 1)
statement: Let N, m ∈ ℕ and let Q ⊆ ℝ^N = Euclid N be a linear subspace with dim Q = m (Module.finrank ℝ Q = m). Let H^m := μHE[m] be Mathlib's Euclidean-normalized m-dimensional Hausdorff measure on ℝ^N (Euclidean metric), and let ω_m := unitBallVolume m = volume (ball (0 : Euclid m) 1), the Lebesgue measure of the open unit ball of ℝ^m. Then for every real s > 0, H^m(Q ∩ B_s(0)) = ω_m · s^m, as an equality in [0, ∞] with s^m entered as ENNReal.ofReal (s ^ m).
lean_statement: ∀ (N m : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid N)), Module.finrank ℝ Q = m → ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → μHE[m] ((Q : Set (Euclid N)) ∩ ball 0 s) = unitBallVolume m * ENNReal.ofReal (s ^ m)
